# PSARA Consultant India — AI / LLM Context File
> Last updated: 2026-07-29

## About
PSARA Consultant India assists companies and entrepreneurs in obtaining PSARA Licenses under the Private Security Agencies (Regulation) Act, 2005 across 28+ States and UTs. Headquartered in Jaipur, Rajasthan with desks across Delhi NCR, Gujarat, Madhya Pradesh, Uttar Pradesh, Punjab, and Chhattisgarh.

## Core Services
- PSARA License Registration: End-to-end Controlling Authority filing across states
- Company Registration for PSARA: Pvt Ltd / LLP incorporation with security-ready object clauses
- Training Institute MOU: Facilitation with State-recognised security training institutes
- Police Verification Support: Director antecedent and character verification liaison
- Labour Compliance: EPFO, ESIC, wage compliance for security agencies
- ROC Filing: Annual returns and corporate compliance
- Multi-State PSARA Strategy: Expansion sequencing across states

## PSARA License — Key Information
- PSARA Act 2005 governs private security agencies in India
- Each State has its own Controlling Authority — no single all-India license
- Typical validity: 5 years (some states: 1 year)
- Indicative fees: ₹5,000 (1 district), ₹10,000 (multi-district), ₹25,000 (entire state)
- Timeline: 30–70+ days depending on state and verification
- Key requirements: registered office, training MOU, police verification, affidavits
- 1-year validity states: Madhya Pradesh, Chhattisgarh, Uttarakhand
